overview: A pixel-perfect React + Bootstrap 5 clone of sweetyicecream.com — a family-made ice cream brand website featuring a flavor grid, scrolling banners, story section, gallery, and newsletter signup.
features: 8 sections: Navbar, Hero, Flavors, Scrolling Banner, Story, Gallery, Newsletter, Footer
Real ice cream photos replacing original mochi imagery
Fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop
